title: Deploy a Dash with a no-change finding
summary: When a no-change Dash selects deployment and reaches its pinned release wait, composition enrolls it in a run of its completion flow through ordinary member admission. A live or succeeded completion membership covers the finding. Until a run lists the item, the done gate and next action name the same add-item or run-creation command. The recorded finding still needs delivery and any applicable QA or approval to close.
